title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps | TechCrunch
summary: As initially reported by GeekWire and detailed in Microsoft’s support documentation , the tech giant will combine the functionality of its consumer-facing Copilot app and the more business-oriented Microsoft 365 Copilot app.
